modules.name: Web Panel
modules.description: The admin web panel with features W13 to W20 for visitor records, documents, reports, activity log, notifications, family dashboard, age groups and watchman management.

requirements.title: Visitor record view
requirements.description: Admin can view visitor entries per project. This is view only.

requirements.title: Society documents view
requirements.description: Admin can view documents per project. This is view only.

requirements.title: Reports
requirements.description: Admin can see reports on closure time, delays, reopen count and top problem categories.

requirements.title: Activity log
requirements.description: Admin can see who did what and when.

requirements.title: Notifications for assignments, delays and escalations
requirements.description: Admin and the Assigned Person receive notifications about new assignments, delays and escalations.

requirements.title: Family and Member Dashboard
requirements.description: Admin can see families, members by age group, and owners vs tenants, per project, building and flat.

requirements.title: Age group setup
requirements.description: Admin can name the age groups and set their age limits.

requirements.title: Watchman management
requirements.description: Admin can create or remove Watchman logins for any project.
